company_info.company_description: "DSW Energy is a top-rated, All-Star provider of solar and battery systems, serving residential and commercial customers across Australia since 2015.We specialise in providing tailored energy solutions, using only premium products from trusted brands.Our focus is on delivering long-term value and maximum savings over the life of your system. Our commitment to quality extends to our SAA-accredited installers and our leading post-installation support.We provide a curated selection of solar panels from industry leaders like Longi, Aiko, and Risen. For batteries, we offer a range of reliable options, including systems from SolaX, Sungrow, FoxESS, Anker, Sigenergy, and Tesla. This ensures we can design a system that perfectly fits your unique needs and budget."
company_info.specializations: providing tailored energy solutions, using only premium products from trusted brands
